pattern.paired_ports: Copy x0 to95, x47 to48, then y0 to95 and y47 to48. One-pixel registration preserves matching stone/joint ports at all 48px boundaries.
pattern.phase_rule: (world_tile_x % 2) + 2 * (world_tile_y % 2); use one world origin across connected paving. Phases are not freely interchangeable fill variants.

edge_finish.core: One-artwork-pixel stone.joint boundary caps cut edge stones. No black ground outline.
edge_finish.mixed_junction_rule: Clip each contact trim to the actual underlying material mask per pixel; draw the common stone body above. Never assign one surround type to an entire mixed tile.

moss.placement: Optional stationary accents clipped to stone coverage and dark mortar/shadow pixels; keep travel center clear.
moss.sampling: Harden source coverage at128, retain all components, crop each cell to its occupied bounds, uniformly sample longest side to20 artwork pixels, center on24x24.

scope: Staged asset pack only. No active maps, runtime selectors, movement, collision or renderer changes.
review: Native material pattern, 47 shapes on both surrounds, all texture phase adjacencies, paved square and narrow walkway, grass/dirt/stone junctions, existing building and approved HD character scale.

source_derivation.paving_offset_reference.png: Exact toroidal offset of paving_authored.png by half its source width and height, exposing its original wrap discontinuities at the center for drawn seam repair.
source_derivation.paving_seams_authored.png: Image generation redraw of the exposed center seam, guided by the offset reference. Final technical export restores the four-artwork-pixel reference perimeter, then registers paired one-pixel tile ports.
